title: consolidated.v1 payload
description: The consolidated decision for one symbol, as cloudflare-api/src/consolidated/pipeline.js (runConsolidated) composes it: Vincent's technical engine (the majority) run in process, Ryan's fundamentals (a minority that can only step a buy down one step), and the index hurdle (a buy must beat every benchmark or it is held). Short, mid and long are fully independent; a consumer must never average or vote across them. This is a data contract for the object cloudflare-api/src/index.js emits as consolidated_decision, not a model: it must not encode scoring logic beyond the legality already enforced in code.

version.description: Exact match, read from cloudflare-api/config/consolidation.json's own version field. Any other value is rejected outright.

producer.description: Vincent's engine identifier ('vincent-stock-decision-dashboard', technical-engine.js PRODUCER). Null only when the technical engine failed entirely for this symbol (see errors.technical).

generated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp, Z-suffixed. When the pipeline composed this decision.

current_price.description: The price the pipeline evaluated against. Null only when the technical engine could not load a usable quote.

priceRange.description: An inclusive price band. low < high is a real invariant but is not enforced here (a cross-field numeric comparison JSON Schema draft 2020-12 cannot express); enforce it in tests/test_invariants.py once that file exists, matching contracts/decision/'s precedent.

horizons.description: All three horizons are always present. A horizon the pipeline could not evaluate still appears, with technical: null and an adjustments entry explaining why, rather than being omitted.

horizonDecision.description: One horizon's composed decision (final-decision.js composeHorizon). final_action is what the UI must show as the decision; technical.action is Vincent's own pre-adjustment call, kept visible but never itself the thing rendered as the recommendation (spec: 'nothing reads as a buy unless it beats the indices').

final_action.description: Null only when technical is null (the engine produced no opinion for this horizon at all).

adjustments.description: Zero or more layers that changed the action on the way from technical.action to final_action, in the order applied: fundamentals before index_hurdle. Empty when Vincent's call passed through unchanged.

allOf.description: A buy-family final_action requires the index hurdle to have passed or not apply. This is the contract's central invariant.

detail.description: Short human-readable elaboration (e.g. 'does not beat SPY, QQQ'). Null when the reason code is self-explanatory.

horizonFundamentalsView.description: Not the full fundamentalStance object (see $defs/fundamentalStance) - a horizon only needs to know the stance and whether it was eligible to apply here (cloudflare-api/config/consolidation.json fundamentals.appliesToHorizons is ['mid', 'long']; short never applies fundamentals).

technicalHorizon.description: Vincent's engine output for one horizon (technical-engine.js horizonSummary), reshaped into this Worker's snake_case vocabulary. available: false means the engine's own decision.horizons object omitted this key (insufficient data for just this horizon); every other field then degrades to its safe default rather than reading off undefined.

action.description: Vincent's own call, before fundamentals or the index hurdle touch it. Gated by price_state via the allOf rules below.

reasons.description: Vincent's supporting reasons, capped at 5. English only today (technical_engine/execution-engine.js and exhaustion-engine.js hardcode English sentences; see contracts/consolidated/README.md and the loop's investigation in PROGRESS.md).

data_quality.description: This horizon's own feature-confidence score (value.debug.dataQuality.score inside Vincent's engine). NOT the same object as the symbol-level consolidated_decision.data_quality - see the README's 'two different meanings of data quality' section.

compactIndicator.description: compactIndicator() in technical-engine.js: { available: false } when the underlying feature was unavailable, else { available: true, ...picked fields }. The picked fields vary per indicator (see technicalDetails below) and are intentionally left untyped here - they are Vincent's internal vocabulary (technical_engine/technical-features.js, protected, read-only), surfaced for a UI detail panel, not part of this contract's decision boundary.

technicalDetails.description: A compact, read-only subset of Vincent's canonical technical features for one horizon (technical-engine.js technicalDetails()), for a UI 'technical details' panel. Not a second computation of anything used in the decision itself.

fib_zone.description: Free text composed by Vincent's engine (e.g. 'Between 61.8% and 78.6%'), not a fixed enum.

nearest_fib_level.description: Vincent's fib level LABEL (e.g. '78.6%', '0.0%'), not a ratio. See technical-features.js nearest?.label.

marketStructure.description: Symbol-level context that does not vary by horizon (technical-engine.js marketStructureDetails()).

fundamentalStance.description: final-decision.js fundamentalStance() - Ryan's blended fundamental vote, computed once per symbol (not per horizon; horizonFundamentalsView above is the per-horizon view of just its stance and eligibility).

indexHurdle.description: index-hurdle.js evaluateHurdle() - one hurdle evaluation shared across all three horizons for this symbol (the hurdle does not vary by horizon).

lagging.description: Symbols from benchmarks whose result was not 'beats'.

allOf.description: status is 'pass' only when every benchmark beats and the earnings guard has not fired; that composition is enforced in code (evaluateHurdle), documented here as a fixture-level invariant rather than a schema-level one because it spans an array (lagging.length === 0) and a nested object (earnings_guard.status), which draft 2020-12 can express but only awkwardly. See tests/test_invariants.py (not yet written) for the executable version.

benchmarkRow.description: index-hurdle.js relativeEvidence(), merged with resolveBenchmarks()'s role/label. A benchmark 'beats' when at least minEvidence (2) of its 3 checks are true: 12-1 month relative return, 6-month relative return, and the stock/benchmark ratio above its 200-day average.

symbolDataQuality.description: market-data.js loadQuoteInputs()'s dataQuality object, plus the market-context score technical-engine.js appends. See the README's 'two different meanings of data quality' section - this is NOT the same shape as horizons.<h>.technical.data_quality.

market.description: Percentage of 5 market-context inputs (VIX, SPY, QQQ, 10Y yield, Fear & Greed) that loaded successfully.

errors.description: pipeline.js runConsolidated() - present (non-null) only when at least one sub-pipeline threw. A short, no-stack message per failed part; the rest of the payload still reflects whatever degraded gracefully (e.g. index_hurdle may still be usable even when technical failed, or vice versa).
